text: `rsync -a --delete --exclude .build --exclude build gui/ mac:nice-dns-gui-build/gui/ && ssh mac 'cd nice-dns-gui-build/gui/mac && make check && make'` with new KitCheck cases: the pending-choice state for each selector (set on run, cleared by the read after the command ends, reverted on a failed exit), the four ids absent from the plain action list, and the confirm text for each of the four; run while no install is in progress on the mac (`ssh mac 'pgrep -f install-mac'` finds nothing)
why: KitCheck and XCTest run only on the mac (Swift, macOS SDK); no host-side test guards these lines. Proven by hand on the mac instead, 2026-11-11: at this tree make check gave KitCheck 141 passed, 0 failed, swift test 33 tests 0 failures, make signed build/nice-dns.app; with the break (Switches.swift StackChoice.installed: case .proxy: v = nil) in a separate copy, make check failed on 'Proxy shows the status value', 'pending is set ... when the switch runs', 'cleared by the first read after the end' and three more; the copy was then removed.
